problem_text:
A manufacturing facility has 10 different product batches that must be processed through 10 specialized workstations.

Each product batch follows a specific processing route defined as (Workstation, Duration) pairs, where each pair indicates the workstation where the operation must occur and the time required to complete it. The sequence of pairs dictates the strict order in which operations must be executed.

Batch processing details:
* Batch A follows: (WS5, 5) → (WS10, 9) → (WS4, 2) → (WS1, 1) → (WS8, 4) → (WS7, 4) → (WS6, 6) → (WS3, 9) → (WS2, 3) → (WS9, 6)
* Batch B follows: (WS6, 5) → (WS4, 7) → (WS5, 5) → (WS2, 2) → (WS10, 1) → (WS8, 1) → (WS1, 10) → (WS3, 3) → (WS7, 4) → (WS9, 9)
* Batch C follows: (WS1, 8) → (WS9, 10) → (WS3, 5) → (WS5, 9) → (WS7, 4) → (WS8, 6) → (WS2, 2) → (WS10, 4) → (WS4, 4) → (WS6, 3)
* Batch D follows: (WS3, 8) → (WS5, 8) → (WS8, 3) → (WS10, 9) → (WS4, 4) → (WS7, 7) → (WS2, 7) → (WS6, 5) → (WS1, 4) → (WS9, 6)
* Batch E follows: (WS5, 5) → (WS8, 10) → (WS3, 9) → (WS6, 1) → (WS4, 8) → (WS7, 10) → (WS10, 1) → (WS2, 7) → (WS1, 10) → (WS9, 10)
* Batch F follows: (WS3, 1) → (WS1, 5) → (WS9, 7) → (WS5, 2) → (WS10, 7) → (WS2, 7) → (WS8, 6) → (WS4, 4) → (WS7, 4) → (WS6, 3)
* Batch G follows: (WS10, 8) → (WS8, 10) → (WS7, 2) → (WS3, 3) → (WS4, 5) → (WS5, 9) → (WS2, 4) → (WS9, 9) → (WS1, 6) → (WS6, 7)
* Batch H follows: (WS10, 5) → (WS6, 3) → (WS2, 4) → (WS3, 3) → (WS4, 6) → (WS1, 6) → (WS5, 9) → (WS9, 4) → (WS7, 4) → (WS8, 10)
* Batch I follows: (WS1, 4) → (WS9, 8) → (WS4, 9) → (WS5, 7) → (WS8, 5) → (WS3, 4) → (WS2, 2) → (WS6, 9) → (WS7, 8) → (WS10, 7)
* Batch J follows: (WS10, 8) → (WS5, 3) → (WS6, 9) → (WS1, 8) → (WS7, 3) → (WS2, 1) → (WS9, 4) → (WS4, 3) → (WS8, 4) → (WS3, 10)

Each processing operation must run without interruption once initiated, and each workstation can only handle one operation at any given time. The objective is to schedule all operations across the workstations to minimize the total production completion time for all batches.
